content_base64.description: The CSV, UTF-8, comma separated, with a header row, by account and department: no column may name a person (FR-PAY-13).

mapping.description: The file's column headers, if not Fyniq's own: account, department (optional), debit, credit, memo (optional).

period.description: The wage month the journal is for.

source_system.description: The system it comes from, such as talenox or file.

version.description: The period's version: a later one states the period's full figures again and drafts only the difference from the version before. The same version again with the same file is a repeat; with another file it is refused.
